notes: The tuition fee applicable to a non-EEA student (institutional fee) is not quantified for this programme; the collegegeld page only states that a fee applies to students from outside the EEA. No intakes were included: no start date, opening date or international application deadline is stated with day, month and year in the texts. The bachelor admission deadline page is not included in the supplied texts. An OER document page was supplied but contains no text.

note.en: Check the admission requirements and the tuition fee (instellingscollegegeld) applicable to non-EEA students; see the admission page and the collegegeldmeter.
